scenario: No incident — a rolling update in progress, the new pod is still starting
query: is something wrong with invoice in production
notes: Tier C, family negative (docs/scenarios-v2.md, spec docs/test-cases.md § h026). invoice is upgraded from v2.3.0 to v2.4.0 (declared and deployed alike, no drift); RollingUpdate maxSurge 1 / maxUnavailable 0. Three old pods are Running and Ready; the one new pod started 20 s ago and is not ready yet, with one readiness-probe warning — the decoy. The Deployment reports Available=True and Progressing=True (ReplicaSetUpdated): Kubernetes itself says the rollout is progressing. The right answer is a LOW label with no cause named and a HUMAN_REVIEW verdict.
